Q-FOG Cyclic Corrosion Testers
Product catalog summary
Introduction to Q-FOG Cyclic Corrosion Testers
Q-FOG Cyclic Corrosion Testers are designed to simulate natural corrosion processes by exposing specimens to a series of different environments in a repetitive cycle. This approach improves the correlation of test results with outdoor conditions compared to traditional salt spray methods.
Types of Q-FOG Chambers
There are two main models of Q-FOG chambers: Model SSP and Model CCT. Model SSP is suitable for traditional salt spray and Prohesion tests, while Model CCT can perform more complex cyclic automotive tests, including 100% humidity conditions.
Specifications and Features
Chamber volumes range from 640 to 1103 liters.
Sample capacities vary, accommodating panels of different sizes.
Temperature control ranges from ambient to 70°C for various functions like salt fog, dry-off, and humidity.
Features include easy sample mounting, self-diagnostics, and automatic data logging.
Testing Capabilities
Q-FOG testers can perform a variety of tests conforming to ISO, ASTM, BS, DIN, automotive, and industrial specifications. They are particularly useful for Prohesion tests, which involve rapid temperature changes and low humidity cycles, and conventional salt spray tests for assessing corrosion resistance.
Design and Maintenance
Constructed from reinforced plastic to prevent corrosion and contamination.
Equipped with a removable side panel for easy maintenance access.
Internal solution reservoir with a capacity for extended testing periods.
Advanced Features
Precise control of fog dispersion using a variable speed peristaltic pump.
Fast temperature cycling enabled by unique internal chamber heaters.
Safety features include circuit breakers and over-temperature protection.
Integration with UV Testing
Combining Q-FOG testers with QUV Accelerated Weathering Testers can enhance the simulation of natural environments, as specified in ASTM D5894. This combination provides a more realistic assessment of corrosion resistance.
Conclusion
Q-FOG Cyclic Corrosion Testers offer a comprehensive solution for simulating natural corrosion processes in a laboratory setting, providing reliable and realistic results that conform to various industry standards.

Cyclic Corrosion Testers: How They Work
Cyclic corrosion tests expose specimens to a series of different environments in a repetitive cycle. Simple tests may consist of cycling between two conditions: fog and dry. More sophisticated procedures, such as automotive, call for multi-step cycles incorporating humidity or condensation, along with salt fog and dry-off. With the Q-FOG Cyclic Corrosion Tester, you can cycle through all these environments in one chamber. And, with the custom controller, you can easily program complex test cycles or run any of the pre-programmed procedures.
